parsed.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and industrial lighting. Pallets stacked with boxes and crates line the aisles. Forklifts operate in the background near loading docks. The floor is concrete, and metal shelving units hold more inventory. The space appears functional and active for storage and logistics operations.

objects.label: warehouse shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall metal shelving unit on the left side of the frame, painted blue and yellow, holding multiple rows of cardboard boxes. It stands on the concrete floor, partially obscuring the wall behind it. No visible supports other than its own structure.

objects.label: stacked pallets with boxes
objects.observation: Multiple wooden pallets stacked with shrink-wrapped boxes, located centrally in the foreground. Some pallets have red markings. They rest directly on the concrete floor. Boxes are secured with plastic wrap and labeled.

objects.label: red forklift
objects.observation: Red forklift positioned in the mid-ground, facing away from the camera toward the back of the warehouse. Its operator is visible inside the cab. The forklift is on the concrete floor, near a stack of empty pallets.

objects.label: second forklift
objects.observation: Another red forklift further in the background, near the loading dock area. It is partially obscured by structural columns and appears to be stationary or moving slowly. Operator is visible.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Dark gray concrete floor covering the entire ground surface. Visible tire marks suggest frequent vehicle traffic. Floor is flat and unobstructed except for pallets and equipment.

objects.label: industrial ceiling lights
objects.observation: Long fluorescent light fixtures suspended from the high ceiling, providing illumination. Lights are evenly spaced along the ceiling's length. No visible wiring or mounting brackets are clearly visible.

objects.label: loading dock area
objects.observation: Large open doorway at the far end of the warehouse, revealing an exterior view with natural light. Structural beams and support columns frame this area. Pallets and boxes are visible near the entrance.
